description: Proofs whose WHIR/transcript part is honest but whose committed tables violate exactly one relation. Generated by mle/tests/cheating_prover_fixtures.rs::regenerate_v2_cheating_prover_fixture through a NON-verifying export path; never a deployment artifact.

cases.name: gate_violation_only
cases.description: one singleton routed witness cell bumped by one: the gate relation is violated while the copy relation, the public inputs and the preprocessed commitment stay honest

cases.name: copy_constraint_violation_only
cases.description: one routed witness cell inside a copy class bumped by one at a column no gate constraint reads: every gate constraint still holds and only the permutation (norm/logUp) relation is violated

cases.name: preprocessed_root_mismatch
cases.description: sigma entries of two cells in the same copy class swapped: the honest witness still satisfies the rerouted permutation and every gate; the prover commits and opens its own preprocessed table, so only the VK preprocessed-root pin can reject the proof

cases.name: public_input_mismatch
cases.description: public_inputs[0] bumped by one while the mapped witness cell keeps the honest value (the public-input hash is recomputed for the forged statement, as the verifier does)
